name: octopus-llm
description: OpenAI-compatible AI gateway with multi-key rotation, circuit breaker, and zero-cost free tier management.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc bin/octopus-llm.ts --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --outDir dist/esm --ignoreConfig && tsc bin/octopus-llm.ts --target ES2022 --module CommonJS --moduleResolution bundler --outDir dist/cjs --ignoreConfig && echo '{"type": "module"}' > dist/esm/package.json && echo '{"type": "commonjs"}' > dist/cjs/package.json
